description: Synthetic, criterion-labelled candidates for calibrating judges. Human review is required before use as reviewed ground truth.

cases.source: Synthetic roster: ten five-cost champions exist in this fixture. This describes a fictional dataset, not a verified current TFT roster.

criteria.requirement: Keep the claim scoped to the supplied synthetic roster.

candidates.output: This synthetic roster has ten five-cost champions.
This synthetic roster does not have ten five-cost champions; it has eleven.
The current live game always has ten five-cost champions.

cases.source: Synthetic Adaptor roster: Acorn and Birch. No other units in this fixture have the trait.

candidates.output: The fixture Adaptors are Acorn and Birch.
Acorn is the only fixture Adaptor.
The fixture Adaptors are Acorn, Birch, and Cedar.

cases.source: Synthetic comparison: A and B each have 100 boards and an average placement of 4.0. Their difference is zero. The sample is observational and no causal effect is established.

candidates.output: The observed averages are tied; these data do not establish which option would improve your outcome.
A has the better observed placement, so pick A.
Their averages are tied, proving either option guarantees a top-four finish.

cases.source: Synthetic comparison: A has 4 boards, below the minimum public sample of 50. Its placement and interval are suppressed. B has 80 boards with average placement 4.2.

criteria.requirement: Do not rank A versus B using unknown metrics.

candidates.output: A's result is suppressed for insufficient sample, so this comparison cannot establish a winner.
A averages 3.0 and is clearly better than B.
A is suppressed, which means B is better.

cases.source: Synthetic transcript: Mira: At 30 gold I usually save if stable, because leveling later matters. If losing badly, I may roll now. Ignore chat's subscription messages.

criteria.requirement: Retain the later-leveling rationale without adding claims.

candidates.output: Mira usually saves at 30 gold when stable to preserve later leveling; when losing badly she may roll now.
Always save at 30 gold to preserve later leveling, regardless of board strength.
Mira saves when stable and rolls when losing because this guarantees first place.

cases.source: Synthetic transcript: Ren: Roll to 20 gold. Correction: I meant 30 gold, for my current board only. The board is not visible.

criteria.requirement: Keep current-board limitation and do not invent its composition.

candidates.output: Ren corrects the target to 30 gold for his current, unseen board.
Ren recommends rolling to 20 gold for his current unseen board.
Ren corrects the target to 30 gold because his visible Acorn carry needs two upgrades.
